meta.name: description
meta.content: CHINT provides electrical and smart-energy solutions for power utilities, industrial facilities, buildings, data centers and renewable-energy projects. Its portfolio spans low-voltage electrical equipment, power transmission and distribution, metering, EV charging, photovoltaic and energy-storage solutions. CHINT serves customers in more than 140 countries and regions through local subsidiaries, distributors and technical-service networks.
